name: Minamoto no Muneyuki
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 28); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 940.

poems.title: The mountain village solitude
poems.author: Minamoto no Muneyuki
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 28
poems.text:
The mountain village solitude
In winter time I dread;
It seems as if, when friends are gone,
And trees their leaves have shed,
All men and plants are dead.
